# RTGENACE traceability matrix (spec v1.0)

<!-- Generated by tools/build_traceability.py from traceability.json. Do not edit. -->

Each row traces one behaviour from [SPEC.md](SPEC.md) to the legacy Fortran it comes
from, the port that implements it, and the evidence that proves the two agree.
`--check` (run by `backend/tests/test_rtgenace_traceability.py`) fails when a
Fortran anchor moves, a symbol or test is renamed, or a hand-picked corpus case
is not traced.

## Change history

D = divergence between the old Python and the Fortran, found by characterization
before the port. F = automated review finding on the PR.

| ID | Kind | What was wrong | Resolution | Commit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | pre-port divergence | agc.py clamped max first, min second; ALLOCR clamps min first, max second. When min > max the setpoint was off by 20 MW. | Clamp order aligned to ALLOCR. | [`e635902`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/e635902f2734269c222b103cab26f224e80231d8) |
| D2 | pre-port divergence | savecase.py kept reading records after END. | Reader stops at END. | [`e635902`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/e635902f2734269c222b103cab26f224e80231d8) |
| D3 | pre-port divergence | savecase.py accepted more than MAXTIE/MAXUNT records, which the legacy refuses with IERR=2. | Table capacities enforced; overflow raises SavecaseError(2). | [`e635902`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/e635902f2734269c222b103cab26f224e80231d8) |
| D4 | pre-port divergence | 7 corpus cases differed only by float32 rounding, which the fixed 0.01 MW tolerance rejected. | Fixed tolerance replaced by ace_parity_bound / setpoint_parity_bound. | [`e635902`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/e635902f2734269c222b103cab26f224e80231d8) |
| D5 | pre-port divergence | One knife-edge case where float32 put the legacy ACE on the other side of the 5 MW deadband. | deadband_indeterminate rule (RTG-P02). | [`e635902`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/e635902f2734269c222b103cab26f224e80231d8) |
| F01 | review finding | Duplicate unit names collapsed to one setpoint (dict keyed by name). | fixed: allocate_regulation_by_unit returns one setpoint per row. | [`1f71151`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/1f71151d8d8ca65fdbc08dda7314d28a075a48c7) |
| F02 | review finding | Inventory counted collected characterization tests, so failing ones still showed 'verified'. | fixed: inventory runs the suite and counts passing tests only. | [`1f71151`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/1f71151d8d8ca65fdbc08dda7314d28a075a48c7) |
| F03 | review finding | Rounded legacy ACE of 5.0000 rejected valid nonzero legacy setpoints. | fixed: legacy_setpoints_consistent. | [`1f71151`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/1f71151d8d8ca65fdbc08dda7314d28a075a48c7) |
| F04 | review finding | Non-UTF-8 bytes in comments aborted the reader. | fixed: byte-transparent latin-1 read. | [`1f71151`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/1f71151d8d8ca65fdbc08dda7314d28a075a48c7) |
| F05 | review finding | ACE wider than F12.4 broke the report layout. | fixed: _fortran_f prints asterisks like Fortran. | [`1f71151`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/1f71151d8d8ca65fdbc08dda7314d28a075a48c7) |
| F06 | review finding | Coverage report could publish without data for a firmware source. | fixed: build_coverage_report refuses to publish. | [`1f71151`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/1f71151d8d8ca65fdbc08dda7314d28a075a48c7) |
| F07 | review finding | Regulation of units outside their limits needed an explicit invariant. | fixed: 500-seed out-of-limit invariant. | [`1f71151`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/1f71151d8d8ca65fdbc08dda7314d28a075a48c7) |
| F08 | review finding | Knife-edge check accepted impossible outputs (zeros with legacy ACE outside the deadband, regulation inside it). | fixed: printed legacy ACE decides the side unless it is exactly 5.0000. | [`85e4709`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/85e47093a91777c9363a39883a5451cf8e81f3b9) |
| F09 | review finding | Byte 0x85 (NEL) in a comment split the line, turning comment text into a record. | fixed: split on LF only. | [`85e4709`](https://github.com/tedfoley-cog/adms-test-automation-demo/pull/9/commits/85e47093a91777c9363a39883a5451cf8e81f3b9) |
| F10 | review finding | Displayed characterization counts depend on gfortran being installed. | needs human: intended; inventory cannot run without gfortran and skipped tests can only block 'verified'. | n/a |
